question: Which of the following is NOT listed in UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India?

options.text: Group of Monuments at Mandu, Madhya Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Group of Monuments at Mandu, Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India **

 
 
• India has the **sixth-highest **number of sites worldwide.
 
• The** Ajanta Caves, Ellora Caves, Agra Fort, and Taj Mahal were among the first places to be added to the list**; they were all inscribed during the **1983** World Heritage Committee session.
 
• **Dholavira**, which was listed most recently, was constructed in **2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UNESCO World Heritage Sites

 
 
• Nations that have ratified the **1972 UNESCO World Heritage Convention **may nominate sites that have outstanding **universal value to their cultural or natural heritage**.
 
• They get designation as **World Heritage Sites by the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)**. 
 
• **Monuments** (such as architectural creations, monumental sculptures, or inscriptions), **collections of buildings, and locations** make up cultural heritage. 
 
• On **November 14, 1977, India accepted the convention**, making its sites eligible for listing. 
 
• UNESCO is a **specialized organisation of the United Nations** established to advance world peace in** education, science, and culture**.
